+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_markdown_table()

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+from rich.markdown import Markdown
+from rich.console import Console
+import io
+from markdown_it.token import Token
+
+def test_crash():
+    console = Console(file=io.StringIO(), force_terminal=True)
+    
+    # Manually create tokens that would cause a crash
+    # table_open -> inline -> table_close
+    tokens = [
+        Token("table_open", "table", 1, None, None),
+        Token("inline", "inline", 0, "crash me", None),
+        Token("table_close", "table", -1, None, None),
+    ]
+    
+    md = Markdown("dummy")
+    md.parsed = tokens
+    
+    try:
+        console.print(md)
+        print("Did not crash")
+    except RuntimeError as e:
+        print(f"Crashed as expected: {e}")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Crashed with unexpected exception: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_crash()

+from markdown_it import MarkdownIt
+
+md = MarkdownIt().enable("table")
+texts = [
+    "| Header 1 | Header 2 |\n|----------|----------|\n| Cell 1   | Cell 2   |",
+    "| Cell 1 | Cell 2 |\n| Cell 3 | Cell 4 |",
+    "| Header 1 |\n|---|\n| Cell 1 |",
+    "| Header 1 |\n|---|\n\n| Cell 1 |",
+]
+
+for i, text in enumerate(texts):
+    print(f"Text {i}:")
+    tokens = md.parse(text)
+    for token in tokens:
+        print(f"  {token.type} ({token.tag})")
